bong.tagline: The ranch mascot: gentle and used to the camera.
bong.color: Creamy white all over. Light cream mane and tail. Pink skin, especially around the muzzle and hooves. Pale blue eyes.
bong.appearance: Small, with a round and plump body, short legs, light-colored hooves, and a thick mane that falls over the forehead, giving her a very fluffy look.
bong.temperament: Gentle. Likes to rest in the shade of a tree and is not afraid of strangers. She can stand still for a long time while guests pet her and take photos.
bong.health: Vaccinated and dewormed regularly. Because of her pink skin and pale eyes, Bông is very sensitive to strong sun. She needs a covered stall, should avoid outdoor activity from 11:00 to 15:00, and needs special sunscreen applied to her muzzle on sunny days.
bong.training: Walks slowly with a handler. Used to standing still for posing and photos.
bong.role: Mascot and brand face of Bách Mã Viên, in charge of check-in photos, wedding photo concepts, and events.
bong.suitable: Female guests, couples, children, and first-time guests who are new to horses.

bo.breed: Ngựa Ta, a native horse of the northern midlands
bo.tagline: The safest horse on the farm, calm and unhurried.
bo.color: Grayish white. Darker skin around the muzzle, eyes, and knees. Ivory-white mane and tail.
bo.appearance: Long legs, a straight neck, and a tall build for a native horse. Bơ was slightly thin on arrival, with ribs and hip bones showing, so he is being built up with fresh grass, bran feed, and mineral supplements.
bo.temperament: The oldest horse in the herd, so he is very calm and unhurried. He barely reacts to unfamiliar noises. He is the safest horse on the farm.
bo.health: His teeth and hooves are checked regularly because of his age. He does light work only, such as photo sessions and posing.
bo.training: Very well-trained. He has been used to the lead rope and saddle for many years.
bo.role: Handler-led rides around the yard for first-timers, older guests, and guests who are afraid of horses. Also used for photos standing beside guests.

bach.tagline: Agile, enduring and used to trails.
bach.color: Dark bay (reddish brown). Black mane, tail, and legs.
bach.appearance: Compact and lean, with straight, sturdy legs and hard hooves. This is the typical build of a mountain pack horse.
bach.temperament: Agile and enduring, and she follows the herd well. She is obedient with people she knows but slightly wary of strangers at first.
bach.health: Rarely sick. She tolerates heat and hardship well and climbs slopes strongly.
bach.training: Skilled at walk and trot, and used to trails and rough terrain.
bach.role: Free riding in the practice ring for guests who have completed the basic instruction, accompanied by an instructor.
bach.suitable: Adult guests and guests who have ridden before.

bin.tagline: Young, energetic, the star of the farm's TikTok/Reels.
bin.color: Bay (bright reddish brown) with a black mane and tail.
bin.marks: A long white stripe running down the middle of the face, and white on both hind fetlocks.
bin.appearance: Young and slim, with long legs, ears that are always pricked up, and a bright, alert expression.
bin.temperament: Energetic, curious, and quick to learn commands. He can be a little mischievous at times, so he needs an experienced trainer.
bin.health: In his prime, with excellent physical condition.
bin.training: Already broken in. He is currently being trained further in canter (a light gallop) and performance routines.
bin.role: Horse for riding courses from basic to advanced level, and the star of the farm's TikTok/Reels videos.
bin.suitable: Young guests aged 18-35 and guests who enjoy a challenge.

bolai.tagline: The strong herd leader who pulls the ranch carriage.
bolai.color: Red chestnut (glossy copper red). Mane the same color as the body, tail one shade darker.
bolai.marks: A small white spot on the forehead, white on both hind fetlocks (low white socks), and a round dark birthmark on the left rump, which is the easiest way to recognize him.
bolai.appearance: The biggest and strongest horse in the herd. Deep chest, broad shoulders and hindquarters, well-developed thigh muscles, and a shiny, smooth coat.
bolai.temperament: Calm and confident. He acts as the herd leader, so the other horses often follow him. He is not afraid of crowds, music, or applause.
bolai.health: Strong endurance, able to carry adults up to about 85 kg. Because he is a crossbreed, he needs a well-ventilated stall and a cooling bath on hot, sunny days.
bolai.training: Skilled at walk, trot, and canter. Used to cowboy maneuvers such as turning, sudden stops, and barrel racing.
bolai.role: Mainly pulls the carriage (the sightseeing carriage around the farm and the wedding carriage). Also used for cowboy-concept photos.
bolai.suitable: Adult male guests, experienced guests, and performances.

bi.tagline: Long black mane that flies when he runs, the slow-motion specialist.
bi.color: Buckskin / dun (dark golden yellow). Black mane, tail, and legs.
bi.marks: A very long, thick, wavy black mane. Long feathering around the hooves. A dark stripe running along the spine.
bi.appearance: Thick, arched neck, broad chest, sturdy body, solid bones, and clearly defined muscles. When he runs, his mane and tail fly beautifully.
bi.temperament: Friendly and lovable, and likes to cuddle up to people. Loyal and rarely easily startled.
bi.health: Strong, resilient, good at climbing slopes, tolerant of cold, and rarely sick. Because of his thick leg feathering, his hooves need regular cleaning to prevent fungus during Đà Nẵng's rainy season.
bi.training: Skilled at walk and trot. Used to running free in the yard for filming.
bi.role: The farm's specialist for galloping videos (slow-motion) and cowboy-concept photos. Bi is also used for experience rides and trekking.
bi.suitable: Adult guests, groups of young friends, and commercial shoots.

bap.tagline: Lively, loves children, the family favorite.
bap.color: Bay (reddish brown). Black mane and tail, with black legs from the knees down.
bap.marks: A long black mane that falls to one side, and a dark mark on the forehead.
bap.appearance: Compact body, straight back, sturdy legs, and hard hooves. This is the typical build of a mountain pack horse.
bap.temperament: Lively and intelligent, and especially fond of children. Loyal and resilient, with strong survival instincts.
bap.health: Tolerates frost and harsh climates well, and adapts quickly to the hot sun of central Vietnam.
bap.training: Very well-trained, used to being led by a handler and to following the herd.
bap.role: Horse for children and families. Bắp takes part in school visit programs, feeding, and grooming activities.

bisam.tagline: The main horse for the “A Day as a Cowboy” experience.
bisam.color: Dark bay. Black mane, tail, and legs.
bisam.marks: A thick tail that is long enough to almost touch her hind hocks. She is used to wearing the cowboy (Western) saddle and a yellow saddle blanket.
bisam.appearance: Slim body, long straight legs, and a light, graceful gait.
bisam.temperament: Obedient, calm, and very patient. She stands still while guests mount and dismount, and only lowers her head to graze when she is given a break.
bisam.health: Good, with strong hooves. She is shod with horseshoes for trail riding.
bisam.training: Skilled with the Western saddle, walk, trot, and long-distance riding.
bisam.role: The main horse for the “A Day as a Cowboy” experience. Guests saddle up themselves, ride, and take photos with the full Western tack.
bisam.suitable: Adult guests, and beginners who have completed the basic instruction.

bun.tagline: The most athletic horse in the herd, the trainers' mount.
bun.color: Bay (glossy reddish brown). Black mane and tail, with darker lower legs.
bun.marks: A shiny coat that shows every muscle clearly in the sun. A thick mane that lifts slightly when he gallops.
bun.appearance: Tall and large, with a long arched neck and very well-developed shoulders and hindquarters. Bún has the most athletic build in the herd.
bun.temperament: Energetic, loves to run, and reacts quickly. He needs an experienced rider.
bun.health: The best stamina and endurance in the herd. He needs daily exercise to burn off energy.
bun.training: Skilled at walk, trot, and canter, and trained for galloping.
bun.role: The trainers' horse. Bún is used for filming and photographing galloping scenes (ridden by staff) and for experienced guests to ride in the yard.
bun.suitable: Experienced guests and advanced course students.

bao.tagline: Gentle and patient, made for couples and romantic photos.
bao.color: Chestnut (coppery reddish brown), with the mane and tail in the same tone.
bao.marks: A small white star on the forehead and one white hind fetlock.
bao.appearance: Long legs, a long back, and a slightly slim body. Tall and elegant.
bao.temperament: Gentle and calm, and likes to graze slowly. Very patient with beginners.
bao.health: Bao was slightly thin on arrival, so she is receiving a supplemented diet. She is used to hot sun and sea wind because she was raised in a coastal area.
bao.training: Well-trained and used to walking on sand and in shallow water.
bao.role: Handler-led rides for beginners (alternating with Bơ), and light, romantic concept photos.
bao.suitable: Couples, tourists, and guests who want a gentle experience.
